themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: This theme covers AI agents that can perform research tasks autonomously, interact with systems, and drive research workflows.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: This theme focuses on AI tools that assist developers and researchers in writing, debugging, and understanding code.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: This theme encompasses a broad range of AI-powered tools designed to aid researchers in various aspects of their work, from data analysis to content summarization.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: This theme covers the use of AI-generated user personas and data to simulate user behavior and conduct research without real participants.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: This theme focuses on AI tools that condense large volumes of text, research papers, or conversations into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: This theme addresses the application of AI to analyze and understand user sentiment expressed in reviews, feedback, and social media.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: This theme covers AI's role in automating or augmenting usability testing processes, identifying usability issues, and analyzing test results.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: This theme explores how AI is being integrated into the design process and research activities to enhance creativity, efficiency, and insights.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: This theme examines how AI is affecting jobs, skill requirements, and the overall structure of the workforce.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: This theme focuses on research into the behavior, capabilities, and impact of AI chatbots on users and society.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
